blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Five x plus two equals nine x plus eleven. Solve for x.
Subtract five x from both sides, so the x term stays positive. Two equals four x plus eleven.
Subtract eleven from both sides. Two minus eleven is negative nine.
Divide both sides by four. x equals negative nine over four.
So x equals negative nine over four.
Watch out for these traps. If you lose the negative sign, you get nine over four. If you add eleven and two instead of subtracting, you get thirteen over four.
